scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide view of a city street with tall buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a large white building with balconies and a smaller beige building with a rounded top, set against a clear blue sky with a few trees and a pedestrian path running down the middle of the street.
scene_analysis.buildings: The beige building has a rounded top and is three stories high, while the white building has four stories and is taller than the beige one. The beige building has a flat roof, while the white building has a sloping roof with a small balcony on the top floor.
scene_analysis.materials: The beige building has a smooth, cream-colored facade with a mix of windows and balconies, while the white building has a rougher, more textured exterior with a mix of rectangular and arched windows.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, but no other furniture or decorations are visible.
scene_analysis.vegetation: A few trees line the street, providing shade and adding some greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a blue sign with white lettering and a yellow sign with black lettering.
scene_analysis.as_resident: A few locals can be seen going about their daily business, and there are some outdoor seating areas near the shops and cafes.
scene_analysis.as_commuter: The area is also a hub for commuters, with many people working from home or traveling to and from the city center.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: The area is also a popular spot for foodies, with several restaurants and cafes serving up delicious street food.
scene_analysis.as_student: There are a few students studying at the nearby universities, and some outdoor seating areas near the shops and cafes.
